A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GroundingSuite, with matching authors, method, datasets and central experiments. Their complete main texts, tables, equations, figures and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including relocated material.

before.justification: v2 reports original GSEval and GSEval-BBox evaluations, GSTrain training experiments, dataset comparisons and scalability results in Tables 2–6.

after.justification: v3 retains original evaluations and adds model results, expression-length and filtering analyses, and original dataset statistics in Appendix A.

M1.justification: The GSSculpt pipeline retains InternVL2.5 captioning and referring-text generation, Florence-2 grounding, SAM2 masks and EVF-SAM filtering at IoU 0.5. Benchmark curation and prompt templates also remain unchanged. The new filtering comparison evaluates alternatives without revising the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: The training sources, GranD comparison data, GSEval/GSEval-BBox categories and downstream RefCOCO-family benchmarks are retained. Expression-length groups and class-level breakdowns analyze existing coverage; the relocated sample illustrations introduce no new datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: Table 3 adds Doubao-1.5-thinking-vision-pro and InternVL3-78B/8B, while Table 2 removes GSVA-13B and retains GSVA-7B. Table 5 extends the dataset comparison to LAVT. New Table 7 introduces an unfiltered-data comparator alongside CLIP- and IoU-filtered data. These are bounded updates to the existing comparison suite.

E3.justification: v3 introduces RefCOCOg evaluation grouped by expression length: at most 10, 11–15 and at least 16 words. Figure 11 restricts class-level averages to classes with more than 20 occurrences. It also adds an unfiltered-data control and LAVT to the 100k-sample dataset comparison. Existing metrics, zero-shot evaluation and the 10-epoch scalability protocol remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v3 substantially expands the analytical questions examined: expression-length effects in Section 6.3, filtering effectiveness in Section 6.4, and mask-size, position-bias and class-level performance analyses in Appendix A, Figures 9–11. Table 5 also extends dataset-quality testing to LAVT. Table 7 adds an unfiltered result but reuses the earlier Table 5 EVF-SAM scores for its filtered conditions, limiting isolation of filtering effects.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests. The added histograms and class averages are descriptive analyses; wording such as 'significant' is not accompanied by a new statistical testing procedure.

E6.justification: Matched existing scores remain stable, including Table 4 and the scalability table. Substantial new results include Doubao-thinking's 79.0 overall GSEval-BBox accuracy, InternVL3-78B/8B at 52.9/52.3, LAVT dataset comparisons, length-stratified scores, unfiltered-data scores and appendix distributions/class IoUs. Existing Doubao-vision gains a previously missing 91.6 RefCOCO/+/g entry; GSVA-13B's 56.5 GSEval row disappears. New Table 6 reports 81.7 without versus 82.8 with GSTrain for expressions of at least 16 words. Table 5 incorrectly annotates LAVT's 39.5-to-41.7 difference as +1.2; the prose correctly states +2.2.

T1.justification: The gIoU definition and mathematical explanation in Section 4.4 are unchanged. Neither version contains theoretical propositions or proofs, and the added empirical analyses introduce no new formal reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same three contributions: GSSculpt, the 9.56-million-pair training dataset and the 3,800-image benchmark. The headline accuracy, annotation-efficiency and generalization claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 6.3 attributes the larger long-expression improvement to GSTrain's textual diversity and complexity. Section 6.4 newly interprets the filter comparison as demonstrating reduced labeling noise and greater precision relative to CLIP filtering. Appendix A adds discussion of mask-size and position biases. Existing generalization interpretations and fine-grained localization limitations remain.

D1.justification: Annotation-model details, the filtering threshold, existing training instructions and Appendix B prompt templates are retained. 'Codes are available at' labels the same repository link already present in v2; it does not establish changed resource availability. No additional implementation instructions or hardware details accompany the new analyses.

R1.justification: v3 adds references to the Seed1.5-VL technical report and InternVL3 for the newly evaluated models. The related-work discussion and positioning against GLaMM/GranD, MRES and existing grounding benchmarks otherwise remain unchanged; most citation edits are renumbering.

P1.justification: Rewriting is localized to human curation in Section 4.2 and dataset-comparison discussion in Section 6.2. Two analysis subsections are inserted, scalability moves to Section 6.5, Appendix A becomes 'Dataset Details', and existing sample descriptions move into Section 5.1. Most language and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: The empirical displays are substantially expanded and rearranged. v3 adds Tables 6–7 and Appendix Figures 9–11, introducing mask-area histograms, spatial heatmaps and a class-IoU chart. v2's appendix sample Figures 7–8 become main-text Figures 4–5 with revised captions. Benchmark table rows are added, removed or reordered, while retained pipeline diagrams, qualitative panels and prompt displays preserve their content.

improvement.justification: The added LAVT and expression-length evaluations, broader model comparisons and dataset analyses provide useful supporting evidence beyond v2. Their benefit is limited by Table 7's inadequately isolated filtering comparison, missing model attribution for Figure 11 and the new incorrect LAVT improvement annotation in Table 5. These reporting weaknesses temper the gains, but the additional evidence provides a modest net improvement while preserving the original core results.
